applies_to.launch: -p --output-format stream-json (via claude-code-sdk 1.7.0 in the pair driver)

time_policy.reported: timestamp (RFC 3339, ms) on assistant and user records
time_policy.fallback: latest preceding reported time in this artifact; capture start when none precedes

tool_kind_table.note: Name table only. The kind describes the request; no OS effect is asserted.

rules.activity: 1 Partial when message.stop_reason is null, 2 Completed otherwise (rule claude.stream.activity.v1)
rules.usage: message.usage -> usage_observation scope 2 Model response, status 1 Provisional while stop_reason is null (rule claude.stream.usage_status.v1; F2 evidence)

rules.residual: block in arguments; whole record in data

rules.status: status_id 1/2 from block.is_error when present (Reported); 0 Unknown with basis 3 when is_error absent
rules.permission: tool_result_meta[i].permission_decision where tool_result_meta[i].id == block.tool_use_id -> permission_decision scope 1 Tool call, attribution 1 Unique
rules.residual: tool_use_result in structured_result; whole record in data

rules.usage: usage -> scope 4 Run status 2 Final (rule claude.stream.result_usage.v1); modelUsage[m] -> scope 6 Model status 2 Final with model_ref{name=m, provider_kind=provider, provider_basis 1 Reported}
rules.cost: total_cost_usd -> cost_observation total_cost, currency USD, scope 4 Run, cost_basis = modelUsage[*].costBasis when single model
rules.permission: permission_denials[] -> permission_decisions at scope 4 Run (none when empty)
rules.status: status_id 1 when subtype == success and is_error == false, else 2 (Reported)

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8 or not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing

unavailable_at_source: user prompt content (the SDK input is not echoed as a stream record)
final per-response usage and stop_reason (stream reports stop_reason null and provisional usage; see transcript contract)
